answer: Ration identity issuance with a sealed-bid slot auction on every tide: fixed 50 slots, one whisper per applicant, a single uniform clearing price, and slots leased 24 epochs then re-won. Unsold slots drain into a lagoon reserve that reopens only after honest demand refills it. A farmer needing 400 clones must win 400 bids inside one tide, and his own demand lifts the clearing price on every slot he takes: at 8x base, the lease bills 3,200x the base price of one identity, not 400x. A lone newcomer bids once, pays the same price, never re-bids.
